sentences.en: Apart from a few faults, he is a trustworthy partner.
sentences.zh: 除了几个小缺点外，他是个可靠的合作对象。

sentences.en: You should have your house built by a trustworthy builder.
sentences.zh: 你应该找一个可靠的建筑商来建你的房子。

sentences.en: You should associate with people who you believe are trustworthy.
sentences.zh: 你应该和你相信是可靠的人交往。

senses.zh: 值得信赖的，可靠的,把稳,妥靠,信实
